ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $OC \perp AB$ at point O, $OD$ bisects $\angle BOC$, $OE$ bisects $\angle AOD$. Find the degree measure of $\angle BOD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $OC \perp AB$,\\
it follows that $\angle BOC = \angle AOC = 90^\circ$,\\
since $OD$ bisects $\angle BOC$,\\
it follows that $\angle BOD = \angle COD = \frac{1}{2}\angle BOC = 45^\circ = \boxed{45^\circ}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, A, O, and B are on the same horizontal straight line, with O in the middle; ray OC goes vertically upward from O; ray OD extends from O toward the upper right, located between OB and OC; ray OE extends from O toward the upper left. The problem statement indicates that OC ⟂ AB at O, OD bisects ∠BOC, and OE bisects ∠AOD. Reasoning: Because OC is perpendicular to straight line AB, and OB is a ray on straight line AB pointing from O to B, ∠BOC is a right angle, with a measure of 90°. Also because OD bisects ∠BOC, ∠BOD is equal to half of ∠BOC, that is, ∠BOD = 90° ÷ 2 = 45°.
